title: Bids
description: View and manage bids on task requests.

help.title: About Bids
help.overview: A bid is a provider's quote on a task request: amount, delivery days, and a written proposal. The requester accepts one bid, which awards the task and opens an order.

sections.title: Placing a bid
items: The task request must be open and not expired, and must belong to someone else.
One live bid per bidder and request. The bidder and the currency are set by the server, from the caller and the request.
Bids are not edited after placing; withdraw and bid again instead.

sections.title: Statuses and actions
sections.body: Only a pending bid can be accepted or rejected.
items: Accept (requester only): this bid becomes accepted, every other pending bid on the request is rejected, the request becomes awarded, and a pending order is opened with the bid amount and a due date from its delivery days. Bidders are notified.
Reject: the requester declines it, or the bidder withdraws it. Only a declined bidder is notified.

sections.title: Who sees what
sections.body: Bids are private to the bidder and the requester.
items: A non-administrator sees their own bids and the bids on their own requests, never a competitor's.
The bidder, or an administrator, can delete a bid while it is still pending.
